# Cron run journal

runs.txt is one day of job runs, space separated, no header: time job host status secs note.
Job and status are whole values: `backup-db-weekly` is a different job from `backup-db`, and `FAIL-RETRY` is a failure that the scheduler retried successfully later, so it is not `FAIL`.

turns.prompt: How many runs of the job backup-db have status FAIL in cron/runs.txt? cron/README.md defines the terms; reply with the number.
Now add up the secs of the runs of that job with status OK. Use the file as it is on disk now; reply with the total.
